I.value_zh: 已验收的 v1 中文教程、现有 16 张教程图片、docs/tutorials/README.md、docs/agents/log/ 已归档文件，以及 TASK-007 和 REPORT-009 的原文引用。
I.value_en: The stated accepted v1 Chinese tutorial, its existing 16 tutorial images, docs/tutorials/README.md, archived docs/agents/log files, and references to TASK-007 and REPORT-009.
I.notes_zh: 不读取或验证 v1、报告、图片或日志的外部实际内容。
I.notes_en: No external actual content of v1, reports, images, or logs is read or verified.

O.value_zh: 读者画像和学习目标显式化的 v2 中文教程、逐章三条小结、末尾“指挥 agent 的 N 条铁律”章节；N 推荐 5–7 且不得超过 7，具体由接收者决定。
O.value_en: A v2 Chinese tutorial with explicit reader profile and objectives, three-item chapter summaries, and a final “N iron rules for directing agents” chapter; five to seven is recommended, seven is the mandatory maximum, and the recipient chooses N.
O.notes_zh: 原文将 N 的选择交给接收者；5–7 是建议区间，不超过 7 才是强制上限。
O.notes_en: The source delegates the choice of N to the recipient; five to seven is guidance, while at most seven is the binding cap.

A.value_zh: 重写 v2 中文教程头部、每章小结和末尾铁律章节；保留原有图片引用；按需要同步 README 的“演示了什么”逻辑。
A.value_en: Rewrite the v2 Chinese tutorial header, chapter summaries, and final iron-rules chapter; retain original image references; optionally align the README “what it demonstrates” logic.
A.notes_zh: README 同步为可选动作，不提升为必做要求。
A.notes_en: README alignment remains optional and is not elevated to a mandatory action.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 是任务发起和 v2 方向确认主体，ME 是任务接收主体；教程中的 agent 是教学对象而非经授权执行者。
P.value_en: ADMIN originates and confirms the v2 direction, and ME is the recipient; agents in the tutorial are teaching subjects, not authorized executors.
P.notes_zh: 不从 ADMIN、ME 或 agent 描述推导任何真实权限。
P.notes_en: No real authority is inferred from ADMIN, ME, or agent descriptions.

R.value_zh: 铁律条数 N 不得超过 7；原文建议 5–7、推荐 6；每条不超过 3 句。其他时间、预算或资源约束未提供。
R.value_en: Iron-rule count N must not exceed seven; the source suggests five to seven and recommends six; each rule is at most three sentences. No other time, budget, or resource constraint is provided.
R.notes_zh: 七条与三句上限已明确；建议区间不是强制下限，具体取值属于受约束的写作选择。
R.notes_en: The seven-rule and three-sentence caps are specified; the suggested range does not impose a mandatory lower bound.

V.value_zh: TASK-007、REPORT-009、FCoP、fcop-mcp、docs/agents/log/ 与 README 的原文引用。
V.value_en: Source references to TASK-007, REPORT-009, FCoP, fcop-mcp, docs/agents/log/, and README.
V.notes_zh: 不验证外部文档和工具行为。
V.notes_en: External documents and tool behavior are not verified.

C.value_zh: 头部 200 字内包含指定主题表达、三个读者框、每章三条小结、N≤7 的独立铁律章、原 16 图继续引用和 ReadLints 无错均可检查；“类似表述”“人话”“头 5 分钟要复赢”等标准没有客观阈值。
C.value_en: Header wording within 200, three reader boxes, three-item chapter summaries, an independent N≤7 iron-rules chapter, retention of 16 image references, and clean ReadLints are checkable; “similar wording,” “plain language,” and a compelling first five minutes lack objective thresholds.
C.notes_zh: 不把主观传播效果转换成二值完成事实。
C.notes_en: Subjective communication impact is not converted into a binary completion fact.

B.value_zh: 不得重拍截图、重命名 01..16 图片、修改已归档日志、修改英文版，或产出封面图、SEO 标题、elevator pitch；不得为了凑数把铁律超过 7 条。
B.value_en: Do not reshoot screenshots, rename 01..16 images, modify archived logs, modify the English version, or produce cover art, SEO title, or elevator pitch; do not exceed seven iron rules merely to fill space.
B.notes_zh: 不添加未提供的发布或主机策略。
B.notes_en: No unprovided publication or host policy is added.
